requirements.description: User wants the property near green spaces. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

The user prefers an energy class of D or better, so the filter keeps classes A1 through D. The other requirements (600 sqm gross floor area, capacity for 45 people, proximity to green spaces) are not energy-related columns and are not filtered here.
The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area, so the total surface area must be greater than or equal to 600.

output.explanation: Filters on school-type properties (Attività scolastiche) with surface_area >= 600 sqm, within 3.0 km of the given coordinates, green score >= 74, and energy class D or better (A1–A4, B, C, D). Results are ordered by haversine distance from the supplied coordinates. The 45-person capacity is not a requirement in the extracted list, so it is not filtered on.
